elevate.move: Give the one real photograph a job and a palette: swap the closing frame for the straightest, newest fence run in the library, map it to a pine-to-paper duotone, and reveal it by the string itself: at Stake B the drawn picket run from the estimator is laid over the photo and clip-wipes away left to right, so the drawing literally becomes the built fence.

Break from the sibling's cream-plate look by making the string own the page grid: one continuous rust line that never breaks from hero to footer, with every section physically hung from it at its post mark (services cards, review tags, FAQ items swinging on stake tags) and the post-depth section as the one place the line turns 90° and drops to the frost tick, so the system is a path, not a row of plates.
